comments.body:
## Duration analysis — frozen result

Snapshot and population
- Tracker snapshot: `6164b3954347d266799a0302aa3abf028e54b322` (analysis upper bound `2026-08-23T21:15:00Z`).
- Provider-contamination boundary: Gerrit 1494 / commit `c390cef54ac8abdc41808c16d18590d2430a1b3b`, merged `2026-08-07T12:34:40Z`.
- Primary rows are active, non-retired sidecars with the expected operation schema, positive finite `metrics.total_ms`, event timestamp at or after that fix and at or before the frozen upper bound, and `provider_provenance.ran_model` beginning with `bedrock:`. This keys attribution to the provider that actually ran, not configured intent.
- Plan schemas: `plan_review_result_v2`; completion schemas: `completion_verifier_pass_v1` and `completion_verifier_fail_v1`. PASS and non-PASS completed workflows are both included because an agent must wait for either outcome. Deterministic/no-model short circuits lacking `total_ms`, gate-error records, pre-fix records, missing-provenance records, and retired files are excluded. UUID dedup found no duplicates.
- Percentiles use Hyndman-Fan type 7 / NumPy default linear interpolation at index `(n-1)q`. Both cohorts are large enough for p99 to be meaningful (plan n=1,514; completion n=683).

Core workflow sidecar results
- Plan review: n=1,514, window `2026-08-11T04:03:19.722469Z` through `2026-08-23T21:13:17.854079Z`; PASS=993, BLOCK=518, INDETERMINATE=3. p50=189.332s (3.156m), p90=325.337s (5.422m), p99=443.163s (7.386m), max=1,311.462s (21.858m). Requested padded interval: 227.199s through 390.404s (3.787m through 6.507m), naturally worded as about 4-7 minutes.
- Completion verifier: n=683, window `2026-08-11T03:55:06.237980Z` through `2026-08-23T21:07:14.625939Z`; PASS=593, FAIL=90. p50=87.253s (1.454m), p90=155.830s (2.597m), p99=748.663s (12.478m), max=2,459.702s (40.995m). Requested padded interval: 104.703s through 186.996s (1.745m through 3.117m), naturally worded as about 2-3 minutes.

Sensitivity and outlier checks
- PASS-only plan: n=993, p50/p90/p99=159.750/281.469/394.153s. PASS-only completion: n=593, p50/p90/p99=83.815/143.289/499.358s. Including failed/blocking outcomes is the conservative and operationally relevant primary result.
- No clean row was sub-second. Plan max spent 1,305s in the LLM tier. The three 30-41 minute completion FAILs on ticket `cb91-1535-fe3a-47fc` spent 1,812-2,457s in the LLM tier despite only 2-7 requests; the 30-minute PASS on `e215-ab23-ed6a-4791` split about 834s LLM and 967s deterministic. These are real tails, not malformed values, so they remain included.
- Post-fix but provenance-missing sensitivity does not overturn the result: all-positive plan n=1,950 gives p50/p90/p99=180.347/319.832/440.180s; all-positive completion n=778 gives 88.340/171.927/709.101s.

Measurement boundary and user-visible plan command
- Source documents `total_ms` as wall time measured around `run_workflow` (`gate_dispatch.py` and `plan_review_recovery.py`). It excludes snapshot/context work before the timer and signing, sidecar persistence, and other work after the workflow.
- This project has `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets=true`. Plan review synchronously runs ticket-digest and overlap-judge work after signing and `REVIEW_RESULT` emission, so core `total_ms` understates visible `rebar review-plan` time.
- A conservative matched-log sensitivity paired one unique clean sidecar with the immediately following ticket-digest plus contiguous overlap-judge tail in non-shared worktree usage logs: n=282 across 57 worktrees, 2026-08-12 through 2026-08-23. Omitted post-sidecar tail p50/p90/p99=90.754/177.168/350.283s. Core plus that tail p50/p90/p99=330.248/488.088/621.329s (5.504/8.135/10.355m); max=1,008.354s. The requested padded interval is 396.298-585.706s (6.605-9.762m), naturally worded as about 7-10 minutes. Including the concurrency-prone shared main usage log gives a consistent sensitivity (n=495; padded 6.552-9.280m). This is an estimate, not durable end-to-end CLI telemetry: usage rows have no run or ticket id, matching is timestamp/sequence based, and preflight remains unmeasured.

`rebar metrics` evaluation
- The registry exposes only gate-economics `cost_per_accepted_change`, `env_diagnosis_intervals`, and `first_pass_verification`; it has no operation-duration metric or percentile. Independent sidecar extraction is therefore required. The current `sidecar_metrics.py` prose saying completion sidecars carry no metrics is stale after df94, but the duration payload itself is present and validated.

Recommendation pending operator confirmation
- Guidance should set the user-visible plan-review expectation to about 7-10 minutes, while optionally noting the core workflow is about 4-7 minutes.
- Guidance should set completion verification to about 2-3 minutes and explicitly warn that the observed p99 is about 12.5 minutes, so an occasional long run is not automatically hung.
- No repository or guidance file was modified.

## Explicit no-LLM exclusion rerun

Re-ran the frozen `2026-08-07T12:34:40Z` through `2026-08-23T21:15:00Z` cohorts with an additional hard inclusion rule: `metrics.llm_calls` must be numeric and greater than zero. All previous schema, active-sidecar, positive-duration, post-fix, and actual-`ran_model=bedrock` filters remain unchanged.

Result: the primary statistics are unchanged because the provider-provenance filter had already implied an actual model run.
- Plan: 1,514 eligible before the explicit call-count filter; zero removed. Every row has 21-33 `llm_calls`. p50/p90/p99 remain 189.332/325.337/443.163s; padded p50-to-p90 remains 227.199-390.404s (3.787-6.507m).
- Completion: 683 eligible before the explicit call-count filter; zero removed. Every row has exactly one workflow `llm_calls`. p50/p90/p99 remain 87.253/155.830/748.663s; padded p50-to-p90 remains 104.703-186.996s (1.745-3.117m).
- The matched visible-plan sample also remains unchanged: its matching rules require plan-review model-call records, and every paired sidecar has `llm_calls > 0`; p50/p90/p99 remain 330.248/488.088/621.329s, padded to 6.605-9.762m.

Broader-pool audit explains why the filter matters even though it does not change the clean cohort. Among 1,982 post-fix plan-review schema rows, 160 have `llm_calls=0`; all are deterministic BLOCKs, with p50 1.353s and p90 6.544s. Another 32 lack call-count and duration metrics. Among 807 completion schema rows, 29 lack both call-count and duration metrics; the 778 measurable rows all have `llm_calls > 0`. These no/missing-LLM rows were absent from the primary provider-clean statistics already.

For sensitivity only, dropping actual-provider provenance but retaining the explicit `llm_calls > 0` rule yields plan n=1,790 at 188.249/324.288/444.417s and completion n=778 at 88.340/171.927/709.101s. Those extra rows have missing `ran_model`, so they are not preferred after the proven provider-misrouting issue.

## Revised duration analysis — end-to-end command wall time

Why the prior result understated operator wait
- Plan REVIEW_RESULT metrics.total_ms starts immediately before run_workflow and ends before synchronous duplicate/overlap work, signing/persistence tails, and some setup.
- Completion COMPLETION_VERDICT metrics.total_ms times produce_completion_verdict only. A close runs deterministic landing/reference scans before that timer and write/enrichment work afterward.
- Therefore sidecar total_ms is an inner-workflow metric, not the duration of rebar review-plan or transition ... in_progress closed.

End-to-end source and reconstruction
- Parsed 620 Codex rollout JSONL files under ~/.codex/sessions and ~/.codex/archived_sessions.
- For each actual top-level exec_command, linked yielded cell ids and PTY session ids through write_stdin calls to the terminal exit_code. Wall time is initial command invocation timestamp through terminal result timestamp.
- Matched each command by resolved ticket and interval to the canonical tracker REVIEW_RESULT or COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar. Required numeric metrics.llm_calls > 0 and actual provider_provenance.ran_model beginning bedrock:. This removes deterministic/preflight/reuse-only calls rather than inferring model use from the command name.
- Excluded --status, --check, --help, force operations, scratch/unmatched invocations, non-Bedrock or missing actual-provider rows, and interrupted/incomplete processes from ordinary completed-run percentiles. PASS and BLOCK/FAIL outcomes remain because the operator waits for either. Exit 10/11 after a completed model workflow also remains.
- Frozen upper bound remains 2026-08-23T21:15:00Z; provider-clean lower bound remains the 2026-08-07T12:34:40Z Bedrock attribution fix. Percentiles are Hyndman-Fan type 7 / NumPy default linear interpolation.

Completed end-to-end cohort, full provider-clean window
- Plan review: n=78, 2026-08-11T04:32:27.767Z through 2026-08-23T21:02:40.313Z. p50=339.903s (5.665m), p90=790.450s (13.174m), p99=2523.967s (42.066m), max=6692.681s (111.545m). Padded p50-to-p90 interval=407.884-948.540s (6.798-15.809m).
- Gated close transition: n=38, 2026-08-11T07:24:34.780Z through 2026-08-23T13:51:15.877Z. p50=512.945s (8.549m), p90=2237.075s (37.285m), p99=3607.171s (60.120m), max=3724.351s (62.073m). Padded interval=615.534-2684.490s (10.259-44.742m).

Current-regime sensitivity (starts on/after 2026-08-22T00:00:00Z)
- Plan review: n=20, p50=757.474s (12.625m), p90=1057.839s (17.631m), p99=5664.037s (94.401m). Padded interval=908.969-1269.407s (15.149-21.157m). Strict one-event, non-compound sensitivity n=15 gives p50/p90/p99=12.505/19.676/98.912m and padded 15.006-23.611m.
- Gated close: n=10, p50=1694.145s (28.236m), p90=3439.318s (57.322m), p99=3695.848s (61.597m). Padded interval=2032.974-4127.182s (33.883-68.786m). Strict unique sensitivity n=8 gives p50/p90/p99=28.236/58.378/61.703m and padded 33.883-70.053m.
- The recent window is small, especially close, but the strict matching sensitivity agrees. It is more representative of what an operator waits for now than the full-window median. The full window shows that performance is nonstationary.

Decomposition and confirmed cause
- In the full matched plan cohort, inner-workflow p50/p90/p99=170.488/297.748/449.502s, while omitted command time is 154.173/628.708/2147.975s. Both setup/store work and the post-sidecar overlap tail matter.
- In the full close cohort, inner verifier p50/p90/p99=97.956/183.975/291.844s, while omitted command time is 408.366/2109.902/3514.130s. Pre-workflow omitted time is 354.358/1618.607/3383.388s at p50/p90/p99; this is the dominant current tail.
- Current close_precheck._check_work_landed calls commit_impact.referencing_commits for every impact-present close. Current origin/main has 2,690 commits and extract_ticket_refs yields 2,229 unique historical candidates; 702 fall through alias/prefix resolution. _scan_alias walks 5,351 ticket directories for each, implying about 3.8 million ticket-directory visits before the verifier. This is the impact-present residual of closed bug reportable-chalkstony-eeve, which optimized only empty-impact closes.
- Created discovered bug grassy-cracked-morpho (a8ac-48b5-0759-40e5), linked discovered_from this analysis and relates_to reportable-chalkstony-eeve.

Censoring and limitations
- An additional 25 plan and 14 close observations with positive matched model sidecars were right-censored by missing terminal telemetry or interruption and are not silently treated as completions. Kaplan-Meier sensitivity leaves plan p50/p90 near 6.1/13.6m and raises close p90 to about 51.4m; p99 is tail-sensitive. Rollout timestamps can overstate completion by the final polling delay, but terminal polls and strict unique-event sensitivity do not explain the tens-of-minutes discrepancy.
- The current-regime p99 values have small samples and should be reported as tail evidence, not a stable service-level percentile.
- rebar metrics remains insufficient: gate-economics exposes no end-to-end operation-duration percentile.

Recommendation pending operator confirmation
- Base guidance on the current regime, not the obsolete inner sidecars or the full-window median: plan review about 15-22 minutes; gated ticket close about 35-70 minutes. These are rounded from current p50 x1.20 through p90 x1.20.
- Optionally state separately that the model workflow itself is much shorter and that very long tails are known; otherwise readers may misdiagnose the outer deterministic scans as an LLM hang.
- No repository or guidance file was modified.

compiled_state.description:
## Context
Agent guidance needs evidence-based duration expectations for `review-plan` and `verify-completion`. Existing logs, sidecars, ticket histories, and the `rebar metrics` gate-economics lens may contain usable wall-clock observations, but their coverage and populations must be validated before documenting a range. Prior closed bug `exultant-neofascist-bluegill` established minutes-scale latency and investigated provider causality; this task measures current empirical percentiles.

## Scope
Read-only analysis. Do not modify agent guidance or production files. Present the statistics and the proposed documentation range to the user, then wait for explicit confirmation before creating or executing any documentation-change task.

## Plan
1. Inventory available duration sources: gate sidecars, usage/event logs, ticket details/comments, and `rebar metrics` gate-economics output. Identify which records measure complete end-to-end wall time versus LLM-only or partial phases.
2. Define reproducible populations for plan-review and completion-verifier runs, recording the observation window, success/failure inclusion policy, workflow/provider-era filters, deduplication rules, and sample sizes. Prefer complete attested end-to-end runs; report sensitivity or limitations where coverage differs.
3. Extract durations without mutating the tracker or repository, cross-check overlapping sources, and investigate outliers or malformed records before excluding them.
4. Compute p50, p90, and p99 using an explicitly stated percentile method. Report raw values in seconds and human-readable minutes.
5. Compute the requested expectation interval as `(p50 * 1.20)` through `(p90 * 1.20)` separately for each operation, plus a defensible rounded wording proposal.
6. Record commands, source locations, population rules, statistics, and limitations on this ticket. Present the results to the user and stop for confirmation; do not edit guidance in this task.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Plan-review p50, p90, and p99 durations are reported with sample size, observation window, and source provenance.
- [ ] Completion-verifier p50, p90, and p99 durations are reported with sample size, observation window, and source provenance.
- [ ] The percentile algorithm, inclusion/exclusion rules, deduplication, and known coverage limitations are explicit.
- [ ] `rebar metrics` output is evaluated and either reconciled with the independent extraction or documented as insufficient.
- [ ] The proposed range for each operation is calculated from p50 + 20% through p90 + 20%, with both exact and rounded values.
- [ ] Findings and reproducible evidence are recorded on the ticket.
- [ ] No repository or guidance files are modified.
- [ ] The user is asked to confirm the proposed wording/ranges before any documentation update.
